end.summary:
Discussed how roots hold soil, especially during rain.
Gave Bishnoi as an example of protecting trees.
Explained sacred groves and why trees are not cut there.
Recalled the examples with some prompting; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised examples of traditional ways of living with nature, including Bishnoi communities, sacred groves, and roots holding soil. Dev used the hand-holding comparison to explain how roots hold soil and later clearly explained why trees are not cut in sacred groves. Dev repeated Bishnoi several times and needed prompting to add the other examples. At home, ask Dev to draw three boxes labelled roots, Bishnoi, and sacred grove, with one sentence for each.
